title: Market-Structure / Rerating Route Candidate V1
motivation: 2014 Stock Connect + record turnover mapped directly to brokers, but fresh Q4 brokerage revenue was not yet observable; waiting for reported conversion missed a large subsequent rerating.
2014 oil-tanker fundamental improvement delivered positive absolute return but materially lagged a broad liquidity/rerating bull market.
scope: Parallel route for event classes where the event directly changes market access, balance-sheet capacity, transaction volume, capital allocation, regulatory economics or valuation regime before quarterly earnings evidence can exist.
requiredEvidence: Broad professional hub event is frozen before company search.
There is a direct mechanical mapping from event to company revenue/capital/volume sensitivity.
Pre-event company filings provide a quantified baseline sensitivity, market share, balance-sheet exposure or business mix.
The event itself changes the relevant quantity or rule immediately; no speculative multi-hop narrative.
Price absorption and cross-sectional relative opportunity are explicitly measured.
At least one control company is checked to separate pure exposure from generic market beta.
disqualifiers: pure thematic narrative without mechanical economics
more than two unsupported causal jumps
event already fully absorbed with no new magnitude/duration reset
company exposure too diversified to quantify
relationshipToFundamentalRoute: Parallel, not replacement. Fundamental recurring-earnings route keeps company conversion requirements. Market-structure route allows pre-report selection only when the economic mapping is mechanical and quantified.
antiOverfit: Do not validate on 2014 Stock Connect.
Do not hard-code brokers or Stock Connect.
Do not use broad bull-market momentum as a substitute for a qualifying event.
No automatic promotion for liquidity easing.

validationPlan.historical: Test unchanged on a clean untouched window with at least one market-structure event and one negative control.
validationPlan.prospective: Apply unchanged to future 2026 weekly hub checkpoints.
